**Finding submitted: deviation (LOL-CAP, critical).**

**What the document says.** The Agreement's only liability limitation sits unnumbered at the end of Section 12 (p0077): it caps *TrueLink's* liability only, and only for matters under Sections 3, 4, 7 and 11, at 12 months' hosting and support compensation, carving out only TrueLink's own gross negligence/willful misconduct. Searches across the document for "liability", "aggregate" and indirect/consequential damages turned up nothing else — no mutual cap, no damages exclusion, and no carve-outs for indemnification or confidentiality. Meanwhile Section 12(a) imposes a very broad, wholly uncapped indemnity on us.

**Why it fails fallback.** Mutuality is absent (Customer uncapped, Vendor capped — walk-away territory), and the carve-out set omits indemnification and confidentiality. Only the 12-months-of-fees basis is already met.

**The change (fallback target, one surgical replace in p0077).** The cap becomes mutual and Agreement-wide, keeping the existing fee basis intact, with carve-outs for either party's indemnification obligations, confidentiality breach, gross negligence and willful misconduct.

Resulting sentence: "IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S AGGREGATE LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO THIS AGREEMENT (OTHER THAN A PARTY'S INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, ITS BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY OBLIGATIONS, ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR ITS WILLFUL MISCONDUCT) EXCEED THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD."

Preferred-only refinements (USD 1,000,000 floor, "paid or payable", mutual consequential-damages exclusion, data protection/security, fraud and IP carve-outs, payment obligations excluded from capped damages) are noted in the rationale as available upgrades rather than separate flags.
